item: Plaintext snapshots in a private folder (R799, row 338)
summary: snapshot_to_plaintext writes each copy inside a fresh mkdtemp folder (.oo-snapshot-) beside its destination, checks folder and file identity after the copy, and names it by a no-replace hard link (checked rename without hard links and on Windows). Any failure removes the whole folder through a no-follow descriptor; a failed removal raises the R794 error. Crash leftovers are swept at the next snapshot, at start and off-peak only when a real, user-owned, prefixed folder in the data folder, not running, quiet 15 min; others logged masked. Windows: owner/SYSTEM/Administrators ACL; leftovers logged, not removed.
